epics.title: Phase-0 prerequisites & probe battery
epics.goal: Settle the UNVERIFIED cmux behaviors and close the pre-existing bugs the registry would make routine. THE DIAGNOSTIC SLICE (problem-before-solution).

stories.title: Settle the platform and close the pre-existing bugs
stories.user_value: As the operator, I need the cmux behaviors verified and residual #10 / head-40 / P1-F fixed before the registry makes two-panes-one-project routine.

epics.title: Registry core
epics.goal: The book exists, is derived/generated, and rebuilds from disk (16/16).

stories.title: The book exists and rebuilds from disk
stories.user_value: As the operator, I need every marker directory to become a derived, generated registry row that survives a force-quit and rebuilds from disk alone.

epics.title: Safe close
epics.goal: Closing is verified zero-loss: enrich-not-create, receipt read back from disk, validated fail-closed workspace.close.

stories.title: Closing is verified zero-loss
stories.user_value: As the operator, I need closing a tab to enrich my row, prove zero-loss by reading receipts back from disk, and close the tab as the literal last act.

epics.title: The menu (Resurrection Protocol proper)
epics.goal: Coming back is a fresh book that focuses an open project (never duplicates) or launches a parked one at its own root.

stories.title: Coming back is a menu that focuses, never duplicates
stories.user_value: As the operator, I need a fresh honest book that focuses an open project (constant workspace count) or launches a parked one at its own root with verified reentry.

epics.title: DR-1 ship gate
epics.goal: Prove ONE recorded close->resume round-trip on a real project with user-confirmed continuity. Nothing ships until it exists.

stories.title: Prove one real restore before asking for the habit
stories.user_value: As the operator, I will not trust the tool until I have watched one real close->resume round-trip continue my actual work.

epics.title: (DP1-conditional, optional) Browser window
epics.goal: An always-glanceable dashboard, only if the menu earns it.

stories.title: (optional) always-glanceable browser dashboard
stories.user_value: As the operator, I might want a glanceable dashboard that does not occupy a Claude session — only if the terminal menu earns it.

slices.title: cmux 0.64.19 probe battery + DP2 sacrificial tests
slices.vertical_value: Settles the UNVERIFIED platform behaviors every downstream guard depends on; without it the close skill cannot ship.
acceptance_criteria: In-pane hook firing on 0.64.19 observed and archived
rpc workspace.list JSON shape captured; text form never parsed
--description verbatim round-trip captured
workspace.select focus behavior recorded
DP2 results (live-close prompt?, last-workspace behavior, customDescription restart survival) recorded and used to parameterize the Phase-2 guards
slices.verification_method: Pasted command outputs archived to .acos/evidence/2026-07-16/resurrection-phase0/; each probe workspace closed after; written answers for the DP2 questions.

slices.title: Close the pre-existing bugs the registry would make routine
slices.vertical_value: Fixes residual #10 BEFORE the registry makes two-panes-one-project routine; removes two live silent-failure sources.
acceptance_criteria: With two sessions on one project, session B is never offered session A's resume via path (3) (transcript archived)
A handoff generated now lists count == git status --porcelain | wc -l, or prints the explicit truncation line; both copies fixed; bin-manifest regenerated
A surface-less artifact is now REJECTED by the gate; the marker rename/restore no longer re-arms fail-open; bin-manifest regenerated
147-run provenance answer written to evidence (adjust adoption expectation if hook-fired)
--command shell-parse-vs-exec result documented
slices.verification_method: Archived before/after transcripts for each fix; git diff of the two repo-tracked scripts; bin-manifest regen confirmed; pending-resume population unchanged (diff).

slices.title: registry_lib.py: atomic write, schema, casefold index, inode re-link, tombstone, audit
slices.vertical_value: The durable substrate: a per-project write that a crash or a second writer can never corrupt silently.
acceptance_criteria: Contention crash-test 6x60 -> 0 errors, 0 torn (mirrors the measured 180/360 -> 0)
A truncated file load fails LOUDLY (JSON), never a silent partial
Re-link by (st_dev,st_ino) heals a moved root instead of tombstoning it
Audit append is one os.write per line; ordering preserved
slices.verification_method: Crash-test output archived; unit checks for casefold lookup, inode re-link, and loud-truncation; stdlib-only import audit.

slices.title: enroll-project.sh + additive SessionStart hook + cwd==root assertion
slices.vertical_value: Membership on first sight: the book is populated before any close ever runs (survives force-quit, DR-8).
acceptance_criteria: New session in a marker dir -> a row file appears in ~/.acos/registry.d/ with all fields derived
Session in a scratchpad/non-marker dir -> no row
Second session in the same project -> same uuid, no duplicate row; .acos/project-id written exactly once
cwd!=root logs loudly and does not silently continue
slices.verification_method: Archived transcripts of the four cases; the SessionStart hook shown additive (diff of settings.json); enrollment timed O(1).

slices.title: rebuild-registry.py: reproduce the 16/16 baseline reading no registry file (+ DP5 seeder)
slices.vertical_value: A derived index cannot dangle: rebuild DELETES the 55%-dangling-pointer class instead of mitigating it.
acceptance_criteria: Dry-run lists >=18 candidates across both parents including the Vibe Coding-root anomaly (flagged, not auto-enrolled)
Reproduces the 16/16-row baseline reading no registry file
Output reconciles with the rows enrollment creates later
slices.verification_method: Dry-run output archived; 16/16 reconstruction diffed against enrollment-created rows; anomaly flag shown.

slices.title: Seed + one ~10-minute human curation pass (DP5)
slices.vertical_value: Day-one value covering everything; a human confirms each row is a real project (explicit enrollment spirit).
acceptance_criteria: Book lists the real active projects
Anomaly rows (incl. the Vibe Coding-root row) tombstoned, not deleted
slices.verification_method: Before/after row listing archived; tombstone events visible in the audit log.

slices.title: close-project.sh steps 0-10 + four guards + last-workspace guard + agent-03 7-check gate
slices.vertical_value: Closing is verified zero-loss: the tab vanishing IS the success signal; the tab staying open IS the failure signal.
acceptance_criteria: Delete the handoff between write and read-back -> receipt refuses SAFE, tab stays open
Unvalidatable CMUX_WORKSPACE_ID -> fail closed, no close, no identify fallback
Last-workspace case -> close skipped with an explicit message
state/stop-<sid> exists BEFORE step 1 (directory diff); it is the only daemon-dir write
Receipt listed N of M == git status --porcelain | wc -l
Artifacts co-located under closed/<slug>/, status: parked, type: close-project, glob-invisible to Eternity
pending-resume-*.txt population unchanged before/after
slices.verification_method: Each tamper test archived; directory diff of the daemon dir; Eternity glob (ls -t memory/handoffs/*.md *.yaml) unchanged; sha256 read-back shown.

slices.title: acos-safe-close/SKILL.md thin router
slices.vertical_value: Safety-critical logic stays in the script (ran 8/8) not skill prose (8/18); the receipt is script-printed, never composed.
acceptance_criteria: Full end-to-end run on a throwaway: receipt says SAFE only after all checks; tab closes as the literal last act
The skill prints the script's receipt verbatim; composes nothing
slices.verification_method: End-to-end throwaway run archived; SKILL.md shown to contain no load-bearing logic.

slices.title: Blind round-trip verifier (close step 5)
slices.vertical_value: The single most likely silent failure is a repo-reading verifier passing a bad handoff; deny it the repo.
acceptance_criteria: A deliberately gutted handoff FAILS the verifier
The real handoff yields a next-step quote that appears in the receipt
Cap reached -> DEGRADE, receipt marks DEGRADED, close still allowed; no new agent files
slices.verification_method: Both test-the-tester transcripts archived; the receipt's quoted next step shown to match the verifier output.

slices.title: resurrect-view.py: fresh book, liveness joins, tiers, BROKEN red, no green
slices.vertical_value: The way IN: an honest book computed fresh, so a stale registry can never be a lying registry.
acceptance_criteria: Renders today's real state: FruitSync + ACOS 3.0 as OPEN NOW
ACOS 3.0's two live workspaces (4 and 5) render as ONE row
A deliberately broken row renders BROKEN in red, not hidden
No green anything is emitted anywhere
slices.verification_method: Rendered output archived against the known live state; the two-workspaces-one-row case shown; a broken row injected and shown BROKEN.

slices.title: launch-project.sh: focus-or-launch + SPINE 1 acceptance + verified argv delivery
slices.vertical_value: Focus-never-launch kills the duplicate pile-up at its source (worth more than every other feature in the window).
acceptance_criteria: Picking ACOS 3.0 while open changes focus and the workspace count stays CONSTANT (SPINE 1)
Launch on a throwaway delivers the multi-line reentry as ONE message (read-screen marker found)
Untrusted-dir launch is detected and reported, not silently assumed delivered
No registry-derived string enters --command; names/next_action go via --name/--description list-form
slices.verification_method: Workspace count before/after an open pick archived; read-screen marker shown for a throwaway launch; trust-gate detection shown; --command inspected.

slices.title: acos-resurrect/SKILL.md menu + finish verb + loop mechanics
slices.vertical_value: The loop, with inverted economics: resume flips parked->active; finish sets completed; /acos-complete untouched.
acceptance_criteria: Resume flips parked->active; finish sets completed (row hidden in ARCHIVED, never deleted)
Status transitions visible in the row file and the audit log
/acos-complete is unchanged
slices.verification_method: Row-file + audit-log deltas archived for each transition; /acos-complete shown untouched (diff).

slices.title: DR-1 ship gate: one recorded close->resume round-trip on a real project
slices.vertical_value: Permission-to-close is the product and it must be a demonstration, not a promise; one silent loss ends the tool.
acceptance_criteria: A real project: receipt SAFE, tab gone, later resume, work demonstrably continues, USER confirms continuity
Recording/receipts archived to .acos/evidence/
Until this exists, the skill is NOT shipped
slices.verification_method: The full recording + receipts archived; the user's explicit continuity confirmation captured.

slices.title: (DP1-conditional) resurrection-server.py: the 8820 browser window
slices.vertical_value: An always-glanceable dashboard that does not occupy a Claude session (adopted only if the menu earns it).
acceptance_criteria: EADDRINUSE reuse works (singleton via /api/whoami), never port-hops
A hostile project name renders inert (textContent)
Cross-origin POST rejected; /api/launch with a path instead of an ID -> 400
slices.verification_method: Singleton reuse shown; hostile-name render inspected; cross-origin + path-not-ID rejections archived.
